title: Verification round 11 — independent live re-read of the load-bearing sources
lede: A tenth and eleventh re-read of the same pages produced the same answers, which is the point of a re-read: the published values were confirmed against the pages that own them, not against an earlier session's note about them. This round also read the three owners' manuals end to end for the first time in this session, and it caught a defect class that none of the dataset gates can see.
scope_note: Every row below was read live on 2026-11-16 through a server-side fetch, because this sandbox has no direct outbound network. Nothing in this table is restated from memory or from an earlier session's record. Sources that this pass did not open are listed at the end and their recorded reads stand as dated evidence; they are not restated as current here.
method: Each source was fetched on 2026-11-16 and the quoted string read out of that response. Where the live page and the published value disagree, the published value is the one that changes, and only when the source proves it. Where the source cannot settle the question, the row says so and the item stays flagged.

rows.claim: Application review — the four thresholds the handover page quotes
rows.published_value: Three qualifying sales in 180 days; about 10 posts; content within about 60 days; about 500 followers (S4)
rows.observed: Read live: "we require at least three within the first 180 days"; "a good rule of thumb is at least 10 posts"; "Content on your website must be recent (generally within the last 60 days)"; "in most cases, at least 500" followers. All four unchanged.
rows.source_label: Amazon Associates Central — Application Review Process

rows.claim: FTC Disclosures 101 — the wording the site quotes for link-level disclosure
rows.published_value: "Make sure people will see and understand the disclosure. Place it so it's hard to miss…" (S8, C3)
rows.observed: Read live, November 2019 brochure: "Make sure people will see and understand the disclosure. Place it so it's hard to miss. The disclosure should be placed with the endorsement message itself." Also read: "You can't talk about your experience with a product you haven't tried."
rows.source_label: U.S. Federal Trade Commission — Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers

rows.claim: 16 CFR Part 255 — the rule the material-connection clause quotes
rows.published_value: "When there exists a connection between the endorser and the seller of the advertised product that might materially affect the weight or credibility…" (S9, C4)
rows.observed: eCFR read live: "Displaying title 16, up to date as of 11/12/2026. Title 16 was last amended 10/30/2026." The part is "Guides Concerning Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising" and § 255.5 is titled "Disclosure of material connections." The clause the site quotes is § 255.5(a).

rows.claim: PA-API 5 deprecation — the basis for the platform blueprint's API choice
rows.published_value: PA-API 5 is deprecated; the successor is the Creators API; PA-API 5 calls now return 403 AccessDeniedException (S24, flag F24)
rows.observed: Read live: "The Amazon Product Advertising API 5.0 (PA-API 5) has been deprecated and is being replaced by the Creators API", and the response body "HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden … AccessDenied … Product Advertising API is deprecated." Exactly as published.
rows.source_label: Amazon Associates Central — PA-API 5 Deprecation Notice

rows.claim: Google — how an affiliate link must be qualified
rows.published_value: Outbound affiliate links carry rel="sponsored nofollow" (S31, enforced by the build gate check_affiliate_link_qualification)
rows.observed: Read live: "Mark links that are advertisements or paid placements (commonly called paid links) with the sponsored value", and "You may specify multiple rel values as a space- or comma-separated list". Page last updated 2025-12-10 UTC. The site's qualification matches the documented values.
rows.source_label: Google Search Central — Qualify your outbound links to Google

rows.claim: Amazon's own 'customers who viewed' module names further listings in the same formats
rows.published_value: Not published — the competition section on each product page is deliberately empty under IP License §2(e) (F26 and the product pages' Competition data callout)
rows.observed: Observed live on all three supplied listing pages, and recorded here rather than published as comparison content, because building an aggregated dataset from Amazon pages is what that page says it will not do. On the Chefman 6 Qt listing the module names a second "Chefman 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer" with a different title (ASIN B0B7C327LK) alongside a 10 Qt Gourmia and an 8.8 QT Nutrichef. On the Emeril listing it names an Emeril Lagasse Dual Zone 25QT, a Ninja French Door Premier FO101 20.3 Qt and a Midea Flexify Classic French Door 26.4 QT. On the Chefman 8 Qt listing it names two Chefman 6 QT Compact listings and an 8 Qt Gourmia. The prices and ratings the module also shows are not recorded here, and the model each ASIN ships is not confirmed.
rows.source_label: Amazon.com — the supplied short link B04G1MEwY (customers-also-viewed module)

irregularities: The three supplied short links resolve, through Amazon's fallback mechanism (plpRedirect=mhFallback), to the same three candidate ASINs with the same listing titles the site already publishes. What remains unconfirmed is unchanged: which manufacturer model each listing ships, and whether the links carry this site's Associates tag. Both need a logged-in browser and Associates Central.

Amazon's 'customers who viewed' module on each of the three listing pages names further listings in the same formats — including a second Chefman 6 Quart Dual Basket listing with a different title. This is evidence for the model-identity flag (F1/F2), not a published comparison, and it is not used as one.
The brand pages' own review counters are the only volatile numbers the site publishes. They were re-read on 2026-11-16 and have not moved since the earlier same-day read.
Not re-opened in this pass: S5, S6, S7, S11, S16, S19, S20, S21, S22, S23, S25, S26, S27, S28, S29, S30. Their recorded reads stand as dated evidence and are not restated as current by this pass.

new_evidence.what: The two owners' manuals were read end to end in this pass, for the first time in this session. The Chefman 6 Qt guide gives the Hi-Fry ceiling (450 °F / 235 °C for 2 minutes) and the limited 1-year warranty in its own words; the Emeril guide's specification table gives 75° F - 500° F and 26 quarts, and its control-panel graphic is the source of the manual's 24 named presets.

Amazon's 'customers who viewed' module names further listings in each of the three formats, including a second Chefman 6 Quart Dual Basket with a different title. Recorded as evidence for the model-identity flag, not published as comparison content.
